checks.test: HIBASE relocates exact 1000-cell clear/output and fixed color RAM across eight page-aligned screens
relocated input capture and editing leave the old screen unchanged
relocated scrolling copies all 960 cells/colors and preserves sprite tails
relocated INSERT row expansion and DELETE preserve character/color layout
cursor blink preserves reverse underlay, color, scratch pointers and interrupted CPU state
BLNSW disable restores the overlay; reenable and timer-only 20-jiffy phases work
PLOT and CHROUT restore the old cursor before changing position or characters
HIBASE changes and screen clear restore the cached old cursor address
scroll and INSERT never move a cursor overlay into text
CHRIN enables idle blinking and removes cursor before captured input
long CHROUT clear services timer IRQs while preserving caller interrupt and decimal flags

scope: Real 6502 ROM instructions and IRQ frames; keyboard/CIA scheduling fixture, not native VIC rendering.
